question: Captio AI or Google Live Transcribe?
slides: *Captio AI* runs on iPhone and Android.
description: Google Live Transcribe suits an Android phone, because it costs nothing, lists no daily limit and works offline in downloaded languages on Pixel and select phones.
Captio AI suits an iPhone, because Google makes Live Transcribe for Android only.
Captio AI, made for deaf and hard of hearing people, runs on iPhone and Android, so it also works when family members use different phones.
Without internet, Captio AI keeps recording and transcribes when the phone is back online, while Live Transcribe keeps captioning in downloaded languages.
Live Translator in Captio AI translates speech live, while Google's help page for Live Transcribe describes no translation between spoken languages.
Recognize voices in Captio AI on iPhone shows a saved person's name instead of Speaker 2.
Google Live Transcribe keeps optional transcription history on the phone for up to three days, while Captio AI saves recordings in a searchable library.
Ask people before you save a conversation as a recording.
Sound Notifications from Google always checks for sounds like a doorbell once it is on.
Recognize sounds in Captio AI on iPhone works only during captions or a transcribed file, and can miss some sounds.
Google Live Transcribe lists no daily limit, while the Captio AI free plan gives 100 free credits a day and Captio AI Plus removes that limit.
